Super Sons #1 - Trish's PickSuper Sons, a new DC series written by Peter Tomasi (Batman & Robin), sees the sons of Batman and Superman themselves reluctantly teaming up and working together despite their vast differences in personality and lifestyle. While DC’s books are frequently teeming with angst and the threat of doom looming overhead, Super Sons manages to capture the childish essences of Damian Wayne and Jonathan Kent – a reminder that while these boys are superheroes, they both (yes, even Damian) yearn for the presence of friends. The art by Jorge Jimenez (Earth 2 Society) is energizing and displays the boys with large eyes and gangly figures, adding to the youthful and lively nature of the book. The dialogue between the two boys is entirely endearing with very tongue-in-cheek bickering laced throughout each issue with their developing relationship really at the forefront of the series.
